verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships a local server with OpenAI-like endpoints (CLI start/stop, headless llmster, network access), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, parallelism limits, or the point where throughput degrades. The only performance item is an anecdotal single-user speed comparison against Ollama, which says nothing about concurrency.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
